newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Tong Meng sells foreign shares in Public Bank.
newsitem.headline: Tong Meng sells foreign shares in Public Bank.

text.p: Tong Meng Industries Ltd said on Friday it would sell its 21.37 million foreign shares in Public Bank Bhd and buy an equivalent number of Public Bank local shares.
The company said in a statement the sales would result in an extraordinary gain of about Singapore $7.65 million for the financial year ending December 31, 1996.
Tong Meng, which manufactures and sells aluminium kitchen utensils and stainless steel products, said the total cost of the shares it holds in PBB is S$0.3427 per share.
